name: reapply-pin
does: sets the drone's applied-pin record aside so its own reconcile applies its standing order again

name: linger
does: asks logind to keep the account's user manager running, so the drone's user unit starts at boot and survives a logout

name: audio-server
does: restarts the user's audio server (PipeWire or PulseAudio), so the capture source it holds stuck opens again
